title: Recommended Power System
text:
[N. Items for Approval]
Recommended Power System
  Approval of Sole Source Agreement No. 47994 with CGI Technologies and
  Solutions Inc. for Software Maintenance and Support for the Outage
  Management System and Mobile Dispatch System, for an amount not to
  exceed $8,500,000 and a term of three years, with two one-year extension
  options.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).
summary: Approval of a sole-source agreement with CGI Technologies and Solutions for software maintenance and support of the outage management and mobile dispatch systems. The agreement is for three years, with two one-year extension options and a not-to-exceed amount of $8,500,000.
